Name: Shen's Wallpaper and Flooring
Author: cuttlefishen
Description:
[center][size=4]﻿Do you watch way too much of HGTV's Fixer Upper?
Do you cry every day that you don't have shiplap in your home?
Do you have a desperate clawing need for different colored dinosaur wallpaper in every room?[/size]

[b][i][size=5]IF YOU SAID YES TO ANY OF THESE QUESTIONS
THEN HAVE I GOT THE MOD FOR YOU!!!

[s]HI, BILLY MAYS HERE-[/s][/size][/i][/b]

.........

Ok so anyway this is a wallpaper and flooring replacer mod inspired by the designs of Joanna Gaines from Fixer Upper. I also made like 14 recolors of the dinosaur wallpaper because it's cute and I got tired of wallpaper mods always deleting it. So like for spite, ya know?
This mod was specifically designed to match my farmhouse interior mod, and I'm really happy with the results, so I don't forsee any future updates.
If you'd like a specific recolor though, feel free to request it!
Enjoy~![size=3]

[/size][b][size=3]Requirements:[/size]
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]﻿
[b][i][size=3]INSTALLS IN 3 EASY STEPS![/size][/i]
[/b]1. Make sure SMAPI & Content Patcher are up to date.
2. Download & Unzip file.
3. Place in the ﻿“\Stardew Valley\Mods” folder.
[i][b][size=3]
[/size][/b][/i]﻿
[size=6]BUT WAIT THERE'S MORE!!![/size]
[size=4][i]Call now and we'll throw in our matching Farmhouse Interior mod too![/i][/size]
[size=4][i]That's TWO mods for the price of ONE![/i][/size]
[size=4][i]This NEXUS EXCLUSIVE deal can't be found ANYWHERE ELSE, so download now before this deal EXPIRES!!!
[/i][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2914]Shen's Farmhouse Interiors[/url]﻿[/size]

[size=1][color=#b6b6b6]Advertised price doesn't include the cost shipping and handling because there is nothing to ship or handle because this is a downloaded mod and also there's no actual advertised price because this mod is free. What do you think this is, Steam? Nah fam this is all just a goof. I really hope you've been reading all this in some sort of infomercial narrator voice especially this fine print which i hope has been read as fast as possible because otherwise the bit won't land as well and I feel like I've worked harder on this bit than I did on the actual mod, especially since I had to type this fine print out all twice because the first time nexus freaked and deleted it when I was just trying to move it down. Anyway the bit's over thanks for reading all this if you did you get a cookie love yall kthxbai.[/color][/size][/center]
